title: 4 ideas to get more clients for your dog grooming salon - EMTWO

facts.fact: The article gives an example loyalty offer of buying 6 subs to get 1 free, used as an analogy for a grooming salon loyalty program.
facts.quote: Just like your local sub sandwich shop – buy 6 subs, get 1 free

facts.fact: The article names low-cost DIY website builders wix.com and Squarespace as options for grooming businesses, without stating their prices.
facts.quote: there are a few low-cost options like wix.com or Squarespace.

facts.fact: The article recommends that businesses look at cheap promotional options such as coupons and press releases for local publicity, describing them as inexpensive.
facts.quote: A coupon or press release are two easy and inexpensive ways to do that.

facts.fact: The article was last updated on March 1, 2018, although its body text refers to the year 2021.
The vendor offers a BrandClarity session described as 60 minutes long, for positioning work.
The author states on the page that she has 20+ years of experience in brand strategy, including Fortune 500 work.
facts.quote: Brand strategy consultancy for women business owners. 20+ years of experience, including Fortune 500 work
